+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.
+# All rights reserved.
+#
+# This source code is licensed under the BSD-style license found in the
+# LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree.
+
+"""Forward parity for TorchTitan GLM-5 and Hugging Face GLM-MoE-DSA.
+
+The released model is too large for a single-device correctness test. This
+script instead reduces the Hugging Face configuration to TorchTitan's
+``glm5_2_debugmodel``, initializes TorchTitan deterministically, converts its
+state dict to Hugging Face format, and compares logits for identical tokens.
+The strict Hugging Face load also validates every checkpoint mapping.
+
+Install the pinned Transformers reference before running::
+
+    pip install "git+https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.git@\
+01269bc99768ad45f8aeaeb701e1315371e25239"
+
+Usage::
+
+    python -m scripts.checkpoint_conversion.numerical_tests_glm5
+"""
+
+import argparse
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from torchtitan.config.parallelism import ParallelismConfig
+from torchtitan.models.common.feed_forward import DenseFeedForward
+from torchtitan.models.common.moe import MoE
+from torchtitan.models.deepseek_v3.moe import DeepSeekV3Router
+from torchtitan.models.glm5 import build_model_config
+from torchtitan.models.glm5.state_dict_adapter import Glm5StateDictAdapter
+from transformers import GlmMoeDsaConfig, GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM
+
+
+_DTYPE = torch.float32
+_DEFAULT_FLAVOR = "glm5_2_debugmodel"
+
+
+def _build_hf_config(tt_config) -> GlmMoeDsaConfig:
+    """Translate the TorchTitan debug architecture into an HF config."""
+    attention = tt_config.layers[0].attention
+    dense_ffn = next(
+        layer.feed_forward
+        for layer in tt_config.layers
+        if isinstance(layer.feed_forward, DenseFeedForward.Config)
+    )
+    moe = next(
+        layer.feed_forward
+        for layer in tt_config.layers
+        if isinstance(layer.feed_forward, MoE.Config)
+    )
+    if moe.shared_experts is None:
+        raise ValueError("GLM-5 numerical parity requires shared experts.")
+    if not isinstance(moe.router, DeepSeekV3Router.Config):
+        raise ValueError("GLM-5 numerical parity requires the GLM group router.")
+
+    routed_hidden_dim = moe.routed_experts.w13.out_features
+    shared_hidden_dim = moe.shared_experts.w13.out_features
+    if shared_hidden_dim % routed_hidden_dim:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "shared-expert hidden size must be a multiple of routed hidden size"
+        )
+
+    mlp_layer_types = [
+        "sparse" if isinstance(layer.feed_forward, MoE.Config) else "dense"
+        for layer in tt_config.layers
+    ]
+    indexer_types = [
+        "full" if source == layer_idx else "shared"
+        for layer_idx, source in enumerate(tt_config.index_sources)
+    ]
+    assert moe.router.num_expert_groups is not None
+    assert moe.router.num_limited_groups is not None
+    config = GlmMoeDsaConfig(
+        vocab_size=tt_config.vocab_size,
+        hidden_size=tt_config.dim,
+        intermediate_size=dense_ffn.w13.out_features,
+        moe_intermediate_size=routed_hidden_dim,
+        num_hidden_layers=len(tt_config.layers),
+        num_attention_heads=attention.n_heads,
+        num_key_value_heads=attention.n_heads,
+        n_shared_experts=shared_hidden_dim // routed_hidden_dim,
+        n_routed_experts=moe.num_experts,
+        routed_scaling_factor=moe.router.route_scale,
+        kv_lora_rank=attention.kv_lora_rank,
+        q_lora_rank=attention.q_lora_rank,
+        qk_rope_head_dim=attention.qk_rope_head_dim,
+        v_head_dim=attention.v_head_dim,
+        qk_nope_head_dim=attention.qk_nope_head_dim,
+        n_group=moe.router.num_expert_groups,
+        topk_group=moe.router.num_limited_groups,
+        num_experts_per_tok=moe.router.top_k,
+        norm_topk_prob=moe.router.route_norm,
+        max_position_embeddings=tt_config.max_context_length,
+        rms_norm_eps=tt_config.norm.eps,
+        rope_parameters={
+            "rope_type": "default",
+            "rope_theta": attention.rope.theta,
+        },
+        mlp_layer_types=mlp_layer_types,
+        index_topk=attention.indexer.index_topk,
+        index_head_dim=attention.indexer.head_dim,
+        index_n_heads=attention.indexer.n_heads,
+        indexer_types=indexer_types,
+        first_k_dense_replace=mlp_layer_types.count("dense"),
+        attention_dropout=attention.inner_attention.inner_attention.attention_dropout,
+        use_cache=False,
+        tie_word_embeddings=False,
+    )
+    return config
+
+
+def _build_tt_model(tt_config, device: torch.device):
+    with torch.device("meta"):
+        model = tt_config.build()
+    model.to_empty(device="cpu")
+    model.init_states(buffer_device=torch.device("cpu"))
+    return model.to(device=device, dtype=_DTYPE).eval()
+
+
+def _build_hf_model(
+    tt_config,
+    tt_state_dict: dict[str, Any],
+    device: torch.device,
+):
+    hf_config = _build_hf_config(tt_config)
+    model = GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM(hf_config).to(dtype=_DTYPE)
+    hf_state_dict = Glm5StateDictAdapter(tt_config, hf_assets_path=None).to_hf(
+        tt_state_dict
+    )
+    model.load_state_dict(hf_state_dict, strict=True)
+    return model.to(device).eval()
+
+
+def _record_routing(model, *, is_hf: bool) -> dict[int, torch.Tensor]:
+    choices: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    layers = model.model.layers if is_hf else model.layers.values()
+    for layer_idx, layer in enumerate(layers):
+        feed_forward = layer.mlp if is_hf else layer.feed_forward
+        router = getattr(feed_forward, "gate" if is_hf else "router", None)
+        if router is None:
+            continue
+        output_index = 2 if is_hf else 1
+
+        def record_choices(
+            _module,
+            _inputs,
+            output,
+            layer_idx=layer_idx,
+            output_index=output_index,
+        ) -> None:
+            choices[layer_idx] = output[output_index].detach().cpu()
+
+        router.register_forward_hook(record_choices)
+    return choices
+
+
+def _print_routing_comparison(
+    hf_choices: dict[int, torch.Tensor],
+    tt_choices: dict[int, torch.Tensor],
+) -> float:
+    if set(hf_choices) != set(tt_choices):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "routing layers differ: "
+            f"HF={sorted(hf_choices)}, TorchTitan={sorted(tt_choices)}"
+        )
+    num_matching = 0
+    num_choices = 0
+    for layer_idx in sorted(hf_choices):
+        hf_ids = hf_choices[layer_idx].sort(dim=-1).values
+        tt_ids = tt_choices[layer_idx].sort(dim=-1).values
+        if hf_ids.shape != tt_ids.shape:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"layer {layer_idx} routing shapes differ: "
+                f"HF={tuple(hf_ids.shape)}, TorchTitan={tuple(tt_ids.shape)}"
+            )
+        num_matching += int((hf_ids == tt_ids).sum().item())
+        num_choices += hf_ids.numel()
+    match_rate = num_matching / num_choices if num_choices else 1.0
+    print(f"router choices: {num_matching}/{num_choices} match ({match_rate:.1%})")
+    return match_rate
+
+
+def _compare_logits(
+    hf_logits: torch.Tensor, tt_logits: torch.Tensor
+) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
+    hf = hf_logits.float().reshape(-1, hf_logits.shape[-1])
+    tt = tt_logits.float().reshape(-1, tt_logits.shape[-1])
+    if hf.shape != tt.shape:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"logit shapes differ: HF={tuple(hf.shape)}, TorchTitan={tuple(tt.shape)}"
+        )
+    log_hf = F.log_softmax(hf, dim=-1)
+    log_tt = F.log_softmax(tt, dim=-1)
+    kl = F.kl_div(log_tt, log_hf, log_target=True, reduction="batchmean").item()
+    cosine = F.cosine_similarity(hf.flatten(), tt.flatten(), dim=0).item()
+    max_diff = (hf - tt).abs().max().item()
+    top1 = (hf.argmax(dim=-1) == tt.argmax(dim=-1)).float().mean().item()
+    print(
+        "logits: "
+        f"KL={kl:.4e} cos={cosine:.8f} max_diff={max_diff:.4e} "
+        f"top1={top1:.1%}"
+    )
+    return kl, cosine, top1
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Compare TorchTitan and Hugging Face GLM-5 logits."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--model_flavor", default=_DEFAULT_FLAVOR)
+    parser.add_argument("--seq_len", type=int, default=16)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--device",
+        default="cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--min_router_match", type=float, default=0.99)
+    parser.add_argument("--max_kl", type=float, default=1e-4)
+    parser.add_argument("--min_cosine", type=float, default=0.9999)
+    parser.add_argument("--min_top1", type=float, default=1.0)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    device = torch.device(args.device)
+    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
+    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
+    tt_config = build_model_config(
+        args.model_flavor,
+        parallelism=ParallelismConfig(),
+        seq_len=args.seq_len,
+    )
+    tt_model = _build_tt_model(tt_config, device)
+    hf_model = _build_hf_model(tt_config, tt_model.state_dict(), device)
+    hf_choices = _record_routing(hf_model, is_hf=True)
+    tt_choices = _record_routing(tt_model, is_hf=False)
+
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(args.seed + 1)
+    tokens = torch.randint(
+        0,
+        tt_config.vocab_size,
+        (args.seq_len,),
+        generator=generator,
+        device="cpu",
+    ).to(device)
+    positions = torch.arange(args.seq_len, device=device)

+                (torch.arange(8).repeat(4), torch.rand(32) > 0.3),

+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch_remat as remat
+
+from torchtitan.config.parallelism import ParallelismConfig
+from torchtitan.models.common.attention import FlexInnerAttention
+from torchtitan.models.glm5 import build_model_config
+
+
+def _cpu_attention(self, q, k, v, *, attention_metadata, scale=None, **kwargs):
+    # FlexAttention has no CPU backward. Keep the real DSA BlockMask and use
+    # differentiable PyTorch attention to exercise the MLA/MTP remat wiring.
+    query = torch.arange(q.shape[0])[:, None]
+    key = torch.arange(k.shape[0])[None, :]
+    allowed = attention_metadata.mask_mod(0, 0, query, key)
+    scores = torch.einsum("qhd,khd->hqk", q, k) * scale
+    probabilities = scores.masked_fill(~allowed, float("-inf")).softmax(-1)
+    return torch.einsum("hqk,khv->qhv", probabilities, v)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("save", [[], ["*"], ["*.inner_attention"]])
+def test_shared_mla_and_mtp_checkpoint_outputs_and_gradients(save):
+    torch.manual_seed(42)
+    config = build_model_config(
+        "glm5_2_debugmodel_mtp", parallelism=ParallelismConfig(), seq_len=16
+    )
+    config.layers = config.layers[:3]
+    config.index_sources = (0, 0, 2)
+    model = config.build()
+    model.init_states()
+    model._skip_lm_head = True
+    model.configure_remat_regions(save, [])
+    tokens = torch.arange(16)
+    positions = torch.arange(16)
+    masks = model.get_attention_masks(positions)
+    kwargs = dict(
+        positions=positions,
+        attention_masks=masks,
+        mtp_input_valid_masks=(torch.ones(16, dtype=torch.bool),),
+        mtp_attention_masks=(masks,),
+    )
+
+    def run(checkpoint):
+        model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+        forward = remat.checkpoint()(model) if checkpoint else model
+        outputs = forward((tokens, tokens), **kwargs)
+        sum(output.square().mean() for output in outputs).backward()
+        gradients = {
+            name: parameter.grad.clone()
+            for name, parameter in model.named_parameters()
+            if parameter.grad is not None
+        }
+        assert gradients
+        assert all(torch.isfinite(grad).all() for grad in gradients.values())
+        return tuple(output.detach() for output in outputs), gradients
+
+    with patch.object(FlexInnerAttention, "forward", _cpu_attention):
+        expected = run(False)
+        actual = run(True)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)

+# GLM-5.2 multi-token prediction
+
+This note describes the training implementation and its boundary with
+serving-time speculative decoding.
+
+## Released checkpoint contract
+
+The official GLM-5.2 configuration contains:
+
+- `num_hidden_layers = 78`
+- `num_nextn_predict_layers = 1`
+- `index_share_for_mtp_iteration = true`
+
+The safetensors index stores the NextN block under `model.layers.78`.  It is a
+full decoder block: MLA/DSA projections and indexer, routed and shared MoE
+weights, input and post-attention norms, plus the four MTP-only tensors
+`enorm`, `hnorm`, `eh_proj`, and `shared_head.norm`.  It does not store another
+vocabulary projection; the top-level `lm_head` is shared.
+
+Primary references:
+
+- [GLM-5.2 config](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.2/blob/main/config.json)
+- [GLM-5.2 checkpoint index](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.2/blob/main/model.safetensors.index.json)
+
+## Training data path
+
+`torchtitan_recipes/tests/models/glm5.py` derives the effective MTP depth from
+`len(model_config.mtp_layers)`, passes it to the dataloader, and selects
+`MTPLoss` only for an MTP flavor.  This keeps the ordinary GLM recipe unchanged.
+
+`Glm5Model.preprocess_inputs()` performs the following before CP sharding:
+
+1. left-shift token ids and labels by each prediction depth;
+2. reject shifts that cross packed-document or padding boundaries;
+3. use `IGNORE_INDEX` for invalid auxiliary labels;
+4. build one DSA additive mask per shifted sequence;
+5. declare token, label, validity-mask, and DSA-mask SPMD placements;
+6. return aligned tuples for the main and auxiliary objectives.
+
+The generic rolling and loss semantics are shared with DeepSeek-V3 through
+`torchtitan.models.deepseek_v3.mtp`; GLM only specializes the DSA attention
+interface and checkpoint schema.
+
+The recipe exposes `mtp_scale` explicitly. Its default value of `0.3` follows
+the TorchTitan DeepSeek-V3 training convention; the released GLM configuration
+does not publish an MTP loss scale.
+
+## Model path
+
+For depth `d`, `Glm5MTPTransformerBlock` computes:
+
+```text
+shifted embedding -- enorm --+
+                              +-- concat -- eh_proj -- DSA -- MoE -- mtp_norm
+previous hidden  -- hnorm ----+
+```
+
+The block receives the pre-final-norm hidden state from the target decoder,
+masks invalid shifted positions, executes the full GLM DSA attention and MoE
+block, and returns a normalized auxiliary hidden state.  The normal top-level
+`lm_head` projects both the target and auxiliary hidden states.  `MTPLoss`
+computes normal next-token cross entropy plus the configured weighted MTP term.
+
+The pre-final-norm input follows TorchTitan's DeepSeek-V3 training MTP
+contract. The Transformers GLM implementation currently omits this MTP layer,
+so the reduced Hugging Face parity script validates the target decoder but not
+the auxiliary MTP logits.
+
+## Checkpoint conversion
+
+`Glm5StateDictAdapter` maps native `mtp_layers.0.*` keys to HF
+`model.layers.78.*` for the released flavor.  It preserves the existing
+individual-expert/grouped-expert conversion and maps the MTP-only tensors
+explicitly.  Tests assert both a bitwise native-to-HF-to-native round trip and
+the real released key shape, including the absence of a duplicated
+`shared_head.head.weight`.
+
+## Parallelism
+
+The implementation reuses the common MTP FSDP lifecycle and MTP TP/SP sharding
+configs. GLM additionally assigns the DSA mask's query-sharded CP placement.
+
+Parameter and FLOP accounting includes both the 78 target decoder layers and
+the configured MTP layers.  In particular, the frozen DSA indexer is charged
+for forward work but not nonexistent backward work for every executed target
+or MTP block.  This keeps MTP on/off MFU comparisons internally consistent.
+
+### Pipeline parallelism
+
+Pipeline parallel MTP currently requires the token embedding, target decoder
+tail, MTP block, final norm, and shared lm_head to be represented coherently at
+the pipeline boundary.  `Glm5Model.forward()` rejects a partition missing the
+embedding or lm_head instead of silently dropping the auxiliary objective.
+Until a dedicated PP contract and test exist, PP+MTP is unsupported rather
+than a fallback to non-MTP training.
+
+## Training and speculative decoding
+
+`index_share_for_mtp_iteration` is a serving optimization. A speculative
+decoder can apply the same single MTP block repeatedly: iteration zero computes
+the lightning-indexer Top-K and later iterations reuse that selection.
+
+TorchTitan's current implementation is the training objective.  It runs one
+NextN block once for each configured objective and does not contain a serving
+scheduler, KV cache, acceptance/rejection loop, or multi-stream proposer.
+Consequently, the model implements the MTP weights and auxiliary training loss,
+while iterative Top-K reuse remains outside the TorchTitan training path.

+# GLM-5.2 and GLM-5.3
+
+This directory implements the shared GLM-MoE-DSA decoder architecture used by
+GLM-5.2 and GLM-5.3. The GLM-5.3 model card states that it uses the same base
+model as GLM-5.2, and the released training configuration retains the
+same decoder, DSA index-sharing schedule, MoE dimensions, and one-layer MTP
+configuration as GLM-5.2. Versioned flavors keep recipes and checkpoint
+validation explicit without duplicating model code.
+The implementation follows TorchTitan's config-first model contract and uses
+shared PyTorch-native components for distributed training.
+
+## Model support
+
+- Multi-head latent attention (MLA)
+- DeepSeek sparse attention (DSA) with a frozen learned indexer
+- Dense-to-MoE layer transition and shared experts
+- Cross-layer reuse of DSA index selections
+- One full NextN multi-token-prediction (MTP) block for the released model
+- Data, tensor, context, pipeline, and expert parallel configuration through
+  TorchTitan's common model lifecycle
+- Hugging Face checkpoint conversion
+
+Available flavors are defined in `flavors.py`:
+
+- `debugmodel`: small development model
+- `dsa_debugmodel`: alias for the DSA development model
+- `shared_dsa_debugmodel`: development model exercising index sharing
+- `glm5_2_debugmodel`: small model preserving the released layer schedule
+- `glm5_2_debugmodel_mtp`: small model with one trainable NextN/MTP objective
+- `glm5_2_scaled_debugmodel`: larger validation model
+- `744B-A40B`: released GLM-5.2 architecture
+- `glm5_3_debugmodel`: GLM-5.3 development model
+- `glm5_3_debugmodel_mtp`: GLM-5.3 development model with one MTP layer
+- `glm5_3_scaled_debugmodel`: larger GLM-5.3 validation model
+- `glm5_3_744b_a40b`: released GLM-5.3 training architecture
+
+Runnable development recipes live in
+`torchtitan_recipes/tests/models/glm5.py`. The released flavor describes the
+full architecture and is not intended for single-host smoke tests.
+
+## Training
+
+Run the small GLM-5.2 development model with the repository test assets:
+
+```bash
+MODULE=torchtitan_recipes.tests.models.glm5 \
+CONFIG=glm5_debugmodel \
+./run_train.sh
+```
+
+The recipe defaults to 10 steps and uses TorchTitan's standard configuration
+overrides. An 8-GPU run combining FSDP, TP, CP, and EP is registered as the
+`glm5_fsdp+tp+cp+ep` integration test:
+
+```bash
+python -m tests.integration_tests.run_tests \
+  ./outputs/glm5-integration \
+  --test_suite models \
+  --test_name glm5_fsdp+tp+cp+ep \
+  --ngpu 8
+```
+
+## Supported parallelisms
+
+| Feature | Notes |
+|---------|-------|
+| FSDP2 / HSDP | Transformer blocks are sharded through the common decoder lifecycle. |
+| Tensor / sequence parallelism | Attention, dense projections, routed experts, shared experts, and the DSA indexer use declarative sharding configs. |
+| Context parallelism | DSA gathers indexer keys before Top-K selection and uses the common compact MLA KV all-gather FlexAttention path. |
+| Expert parallelism | Routed experts use TorchTitan's common MoE implementation; shared experts remain replicated across the EP axis. |
+| Pipeline parallelism | Decoder layers are split through the common pipeline lifecycle; shared DSA selections are forwarded when their consumer is on a later stage. |
+
+GLM-5.2 DSA is represented with a PyTorch FlexAttention `BlockMask`. It does
+not use the packed-sequence `varlen` attention contract because DSA selects an
+arbitrary learned Top-K key set for each query.
+
+The frozen indexer delegates weighted-ReLU Top-K selection to Attention Gym's
+`lightning_indexer`, using the repository's existing `attn-gym==0.0.17`
+dependency. Its reference implementation preserves FP32 ranking and mixing
+weights. Valid tokens are packed by document before selection, and the returned
+document-local indices are mapped back to global key indices. Under CP, the
+indexer gathers query features and weights in addition to keys to satisfy
+Attention Gym's complete-document input contract, then returns local queries'
+selections. This currently repeats indexer selection across CP ranks.
+Attention uses the shared `MLAAttention` backend, or
+`AllGatherKVMLAFlexAttention` under CP. CP gathers normalized compressed KV
+and the shared rotary key before KV expansion. Q/KV projections, RoPE,
+TP column/row projections, dense/MoE layer construction, routing, and MTP
+blocks reuse DeepSeek-V3 implementations. GLM retains its indexer,
+BlockMask construction, and cross-layer selection schedule.
+
+Native KV-up-projection parameters now live under
+`attention.inner_attention.wkv_b`; Hugging Face checkpoint names are unchanged.
+The adapter inherits DeepSeek parameter mappings and reshapes fused routed
+W13 weights directly, without model-specific gate/up all-to-all conversion.
+
+CP load balancing with token reordering and PP with MTP are rejected at config
+construction; the current DSA indexer requires contiguous document order.
+
+## Download tokenizer and checkpoint assets
+
+Download tokenizer and model metadata from the released GLM-5.2 repository:
+
+```bash
+python scripts/download_hf_assets.py \
+  --repo_id zai-org/GLM-5.2 \
+  --assets tokenizer config index
+```
+
+For GLM-5.3 training and checkpoint conversion, use the BF16 release rather
+than the quantized inference checkpoint:
+
+```bash
+python scripts/download_hf_assets.py \
+  --repo_id zai-org/GLM-5.3-BF16 \
+  --assets tokenizer config index
+```
+
+To load the released weights for continued training or checkpoint conversion,
+also request `safetensors`. The checkpoint is very large, so the debug recipes
+use the repository test tokenizer and randomly initialized weights by default.
+
+Validate the model definition and Hugging Face checkpoint mapping with the
+reduced deterministic parity test:
+
+```bash
+python -m scripts.checkpoint_conversion.numerical_tests_glm5
+```
+
+Select the versioned GLM-5.3 development flavor with:
+
+```bash
+python -m scripts.checkpoint_conversion.numerical_tests_glm5 \
+  --model_flavor glm5_3_debugmodel
+```
+
+## Multi-token prediction
+
+The released GLM-5.2 checkpoint declares 78 target decoder layers and one
+``num_nextn_predict_layers`` block.  The extra block is stored as
+``model.layers.78`` and contains the complete DSA attention and MoE sublayers,
+plus ``enorm``, ``hnorm``, ``eh_proj``, and ``shared_head.norm``.  It reuses the
+model's token embedding and top-level language-model head rather than storing a
+second vocabulary projection.
+
+TorchTitan therefore models training-time MTP as a real auxiliary decoder
+depth, not as an inference-only flag.  The dataloader prepares a shifted token
+and label sequence, the GLM block builds the corresponding DSA mask, and
+``MTPLoss`` adds the weighted auxiliary cross-entropy objective.  See
+[`MTP.md`](MTP.md) for the data, model, checkpoint, parallelism, and validation
+contracts.
+
+## Validation
+
+Run the CPU model tests with:
+
+```bash
+pytest tests/unit_tests/cpu/models/glm5 -q
+```
+
+Run the reduced Hugging Face parity check with the pinned Transformers
+reference documented by the script:
+
+```bash
+python -m scripts.checkpoint_conversion.numerical_tests_glm5 --device cuda
+```
+
+The parity check builds equivalent reduced TorchTitan and Hugging Face models,
+strictly loads the converted state dict, compares MoE routing choices, and
+checks full-sequence logits with KL-divergence, cosine-similarity, and top-1
+agreement thresholds.
+
+The integration suite registers separate base and MTP training cases. Both use
+an 8-GPU FSDP2+TP2+CP2+EP2 configuration with a real process group:
+
+```text
+glm5_fsdp+tp+cp+ep
+glm5_mtp_fsdp+tp+cp+ep
+```
+
+The MTP case exercises shifted targets, the auxiliary DSA/MoE block, the
+combined loss, backward, and the optimizer step. Pipeline parallelism with MTP
+is not yet supported; base GLM-5.2 pipeline parallelism is supported.
+
+## References

+"""GLM sparse attention with Attention Gym indexing and PyTorch block masks.
+
+T/Q/K are token/query/key counts; S is selected keys per query; N is heads.
+D/H/R/P are model/head/latent-or-rotary/pass-through widths; V is value width.
+Mask construction retains O(Q*K) storage. Attention delegates to the common
+FlexAttention backend; Attention Gym owns the weighted-ReLU top-k selection.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import spmd_types as spmd
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+import torch_remat as remat
+from torch.nn.attention.flex_attention import BlockMask
+
+from torchtitan.distributed.context_parallel import cp_all_gather_tensors
+
+from torchtitan.distributed.parallelism_context import MeshAxisName
+from torchtitan.distributed.spmd_types import spmd_mesh_group
+from torchtitan.models.base.module import Module
+from torchtitan.models.common import ComplexRoPE, LayerNorm, Linear
+from torchtitan.models.common.attention import FlexInnerAttention
+from torchtitan.models.common.attn_gym import lightning_indexer, require_attn_gym
+
+
+def create_dsa_causal_mask(
+    positions_T: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+    padding_mask_T: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Build a packed-document causal additive mask of shape ``[1, T, T]``.
+
+    ``positions_T`` restarts at zero for every packed document. The cumulative
+    restart count is therefore a document id. A query can see a key only when
+    both tokens belong to the same document and the key is not in the future.
+    Disallowed entries use the minimum finite value for indexer ranking.
+    The attention mask also excludes them after top-k selection.
+    """
+    T = positions_T.shape[0]
+    token_indices_T = torch.arange(T, device=positions_T.device)
+    document_ids_T = (positions_T == 0).cumsum(0)
+    allowed_TT = (token_indices_T[:, None] >= token_indices_T[None, :]) & (
+        document_ids_T[:, None] == document_ids_T[None, :]
+    )
+    if padding_mask_T is not None:
+        allowed_TT = allowed_TT & ~padding_mask_T[:, None] & ~padding_mask_T[None, :]
+    return torch.zeros(1, T, T, dtype=dtype, device=positions_T.device).masked_fill(
+        ~allowed_TT.unsqueeze(0), torch.finfo(dtype).min
+    )
+
+
+class DSAIndexerTopK(Module):
+    """Compute local-query top-k indices against a global key sequence.
+
+    Attention Gym processes complete packed documents and returns indices local
+    to each document. Compact valid tokens before selection, then map selections
+    back to the global key sequence expected by FlexAttention. CP gathers query
+    features as well as keys because the indexer API requires complete documents.
+    """
+
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class Config(Module.Config):
+        index_topk: int
+
+    def __init__(self, config: Config) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        require_attn_gym(lightning_indexer)
+        self.index_topk = config.index_topk
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        q_QNH: torch.Tensor,
+        k_KH: torch.Tensor,
+        weights_QN: torch.Tensor,
+        attention_mask_QK: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        _, K = attention_mask_QK.shape
+        # In the document-causal mask, the first allowed key identifies the
+        # document. A fully masked row denotes an invalid query and key token.
+        mask_values_Q, document_starts_Q = attention_mask_QK.max(dim=-1)
+        valid_Q = mask_values_Q == 0
+        cp_group = spmd_mesh_group(MeshAxisName.CP)
+        if cp_group is not None:
+            # TODO: Keep queries local once Attention Gym supports query chunks.
+            q_QNH, weights_QN, document_starts_Q, valid_Q = cp_all_gather_tensors(
+                (q_QNH, weights_QN, document_starts_Q, valid_Q),
+                reduce_dtype=torch.float32,
+            )
+        if q_QNH.shape[0] != K:
+            raise ValueError("DSA indexing requires complete query and key sequences")
+
+        # Keep token order within each document while moving padding to the end.
+        # Fixed-capacity offsets use repeated endpoints for empty documents.
+        token_order_K = (~valid_Q).to(torch.int32).argsort(stable=True)
+        valid_K = valid_Q[token_order_K]
+        document_starts_K = document_starts_Q[token_order_K]
+        token_indices_K = torch.arange(K, device=q_QNH.device, dtype=torch.int32)
+        starts_K = valid_K & (
+            (token_indices_K == 0) | (document_starts_K != document_starts_K.roll(1))
+        )
+        num_valid = valid_K.sum(dtype=torch.int32)
+        cu_seqlens = torch.cat(
+            (
+                torch.where(starts_K, token_indices_K, num_valid).sort().values,
+                num_valid[None],
+            )
+        )
+        document_offsets_K = torch.where(starts_K, token_indices_K, 0).cummax(0).values
+        # Keep FP32 ranking, including FP32 mixing weights. Attention Gym's
+        # fused indexer requires FP16/BF16 inputs and would change this contract.
+        indices_KS = lightning_indexer(
+            q_QNH[token_order_K].float().unsqueeze(0),
+            k_KH[token_order_K].float().unsqueeze(0),
+            weights_QN[token_order_K].float().unsqueeze(0),
+            min(self.index_topk, K),
+            causal=True,
+            cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+            cu_seqlens_k=cu_seqlens,
+            impl="reference",
+        ).squeeze(0)
+        packed_indices_KS = document_offsets_K[:, None] + indices_KS.clamp_min(0)
+        global_indices_KS = token_order_K[packed_indices_KS.long()].to(torch.int32)
+        global_indices_KS = global_indices_KS.masked_fill(indices_KS < 0, -1)
+        indices_KS = torch.empty_like(global_indices_KS).index_copy_(
+            0, token_order_K, global_indices_KS
+        )
+        if cp_group is not None:
+            return spmd.redistribute(indices_KS, cp_group, src=spmd.R, dst=spmd.S(0))
+        return indices_KS
+
+
+class Glm5DsaIndexer(Module):
+    """Frozen pretrained query-to-key selector used by DSA.
+
+    ``hidden_states_TD`` supplies both the shared key and per-head mixing
+    weights. ``q_resid_TR`` reuses MLA's normalized Q LoRA representation so
+    the main attention and indexer observe the same query state. RoPE is
+    applied only to the configured rotary prefix; the remaining features pass
+    through unchanged.
+    """
+
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class Config(Module.Config):
+        dim: int
+        q_lora_rank: int
+        n_heads: int
+        head_dim: int
+        qk_rope_head_dim: int
+        index_topk: int
+        wq_b: Linear.Config
+        wk: Linear.Config
+        k_norm: LayerNorm.Config
+        weights_proj: Linear.Config
+        rope: ComplexRoPE.Config
+        topk: DSAIndexerTopK.Config
+
+    def __init__(self, config: Config):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.n_heads = config.n_heads
+        self.head_dim = config.head_dim
+        self.qk_rope_head_dim = config.qk_rope_head_dim
+        self.index_topk = config.index_topk
+        self.wq_b = config.wq_b.build()
+        self.wk = config.wk.build()
+        self.k_norm = config.k_norm.build()
+        self.weights_proj = config.weights_proj.build().float()
+        self.rope = config.rope.build()
+        self.topk = config.topk.build()
+        # Released GLM-5 checkpoints contain a pretrained indexer. This model
+        # has no auxiliary indexer objective, so LM training must keep it fixed
+        # and exclude its parameters from optimizer state.
+        self.requires_grad_(False)
+
+    def _apply(self, fn, recurse: bool = True):
+        # ``model.to(dtype=...)`` visits frozen modules too. Restore this gate
+        # to FP32 after the generic transform because its boundary decisions
+        # are more sensitive than the surrounding BF16 attention projections.
+        super()._apply(fn, recurse=recurse)
+        self.weights_proj.float()
+        return self
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states_TD: torch.Tensor,
+        q_resid_TR: torch.Tensor,
+        positions_T: torch.Tensor,
+        attention_mask_TK: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        T = hidden_states_TD.shape[0]
+        # Build query and key features in the same indexer space. The key has a
+        # singleton head dimension because every query head searches one shared
+        # global key sequence.
+        q_TNH = self.wq_b(q_resid_TR)
+        remat.recompute_needs_tensor(q_TNH)
+        q_TNH = q_TNH.view(T, self.n_heads, self.head_dim)
+        q_rot_TNR, q_pass_TNP = torch.split(
+            q_TNH,
+            [self.qk_rope_head_dim, self.head_dim - self.qk_rope_head_dim],
+            dim=-1,
+        )
+        k_TH = self.wk(hidden_states_TD)
+        remat.recompute_needs_tensor(k_TH)
+        k_TH = self.k_norm(k_TH)
+        remat.recompute_needs_tensor(k_TH)
+        k_T1H = k_TH.unsqueeze(1)
+        k_rot_T1R, k_pass_T1P = torch.split(
+            k_T1H,
+            [self.qk_rope_head_dim, self.head_dim - self.qk_rope_head_dim],
+            dim=-1,
+        )
+        q_rot_TNR, k_rot_T1R = self.rope(q_rot_TNR, k_rot_T1R, positions_T)
+        remat.recompute_needs_tensor(q_rot_TNR, k_rot_T1R)
+        q_TNH = torch.cat((q_rot_TNR, q_pass_TNP), dim=-1)
+        k_TH = torch.cat((k_rot_T1R, k_pass_T1P), dim=-1).squeeze(1)
+
+        # Context parallelism keeps queries local but every query ranks the
+        # global key sequence. Match the KV-all-gather attention contract by
+        # gathering indexer keys over CP before the discrete top-k boundary.
+        cp_group = spmd_mesh_group(MeshAxisName.CP)
+        if cp_group is not None:
+            k_TH = spmd.redistribute(
+                k_TH,
+                cp_group,
+                src=spmd.S(0),
+                dst=spmd.R,
+            )
+
+        # The learned per-token head weights turn N head-specific similarities
+        # into the scalar [T,T] ranking consumed by top-k.
+        weights_TN = self.weights_proj(
+            hidden_states_TD.to(self.weights_proj.weight.dtype)
+        )
+        remat.recompute_needs_tensor(weights_TN)
+        # Attention Gym applies the 1/sqrt(N*H) indexer normalization.
+        if attention_mask_TK is None:
+            attention_mask_TK = create_dsa_causal_mask(
+                positions_T, dtype=torch.float32
+            )[0]
+        return self.topk(q_TNH, k_TH, weights_TN, attention_mask_TK)
+
+
+def selected_mask(
+    indices_QS: torch.Tensor, additive_mask_1QK: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Intersect selected positions with the existing causal/document mask.
+
+    Negative entries denote padding. Duplicate indices represent a set, not
+    repeated probability mass. Invalid positive indices are excluded as well.
+    The supplied mask uses zero for allowed entries, not arbitrary score bias.
+    """
+    Q, K = additive_mask_1QK.shape[-2:]
+    valid_QS = (indices_QS >= 0) & (indices_QS < K)
+    safe_QS = indices_QS.clamp(0, K - 1).long()
+    counts_QK = torch.zeros((Q, K), dtype=torch.int32, device=indices_QS.device)
+    counts_QK.scatter_add_(1, safe_QS, valid_QS.to(torch.int32))
+    return (counts_QK > 0) & (additive_mask_1QK[0] == 0)
+
+
+def build_dsa_block_mask(
+    indices_QS: torch.Tensor,
+    additive_mask_1QK: torch.Tensor,
+    block_size: int = 128,
+) -> BlockMask:
+    """Build conservative KV block lists and an exact token-level predicate."""
+    allowed_QK = selected_mask(indices_QS, additive_mask_1QK)
+    Q, K = allowed_QK.shape
+    B = block_size
+    padded = F.pad(allowed_QK, (0, (-K) % B, 0, (-Q) % B))
+    occupied = padded.reshape((Q + B - 1) // B, B, (K + B - 1) // B, B)
+    occupied = occupied.any(dim=3).any(dim=1)[None, None]
+    counts = occupied.sum(-1).to(torch.int32)
+    # Sorting float32 0/1 keys preserves the exact occupancy order while
+    # allowing accelerator backends to use their native stable sort path.
+    blocks = occupied.to(torch.float32).argsort(dim=-1, descending=True, stable=True)
+
+    def mask_mod(b, h, q, k):
+        # Flex may evaluate padded lanes; clamp reads before applying bounds.
+        return (q < Q) & (k < K) & allowed_QK[q.clamp(max=Q - 1), k.clamp(max=K - 1)]
+
+    return BlockMask.from_kv_blocks(
+        counts,
+        blocks.to(torch.int32),
+        BLOCK_SIZE=B,
+        mask_mod=mask_mod,
+        seq_lengths=(Q, K),
+    )
+
+
+class Glm5FlexAttention(FlexInnerAttention):
+    """Expanded MLA Q/K/V with GLM token-selected block-sparse attention."""
+
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class Config(FlexInnerAttention.Config):
+        block_size: int | tuple[int, int] = 128
+        attention_dropout: float = 0.0
+
+        def __post_init__(self):
+            if not isinstance(self.block_size, int):
+                raise ValueError("GLM DSA requires a square integer block_size")
+            if self.attention_dropout != 0.0:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "GLM FlexAttention currently requires attention_dropout=0"
+                )
+
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__(config)
+        assert isinstance(config.block_size, int)
+        self.block_size = config.block_size
+
+    def forward(  # pyrefly: ignore[bad-override]
+        self,
+        q_THK: torch.Tensor,
+        k_THK: torch.Tensor,
+        v_THV: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        attention_metadata: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_indices_QS: torch.Tensor,
+        scale: float | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        mask = build_dsa_block_mask(
+            topk_indices_QS, attention_metadata, self.block_size
+        )
+        return super().forward(
+            q_THK, k_THK, v_THV, attention_metadata=mask, scale=scale
+        )

+def build_glm5_mtp_layers(
+    inner_cfg: Glm5TransformerBlock.Config,
+    *,
+    indexer: Glm5DsaIndexer.Config,
+    dim: int,
+    num_mtp_layers: int,
+    norm_eps: float,
+    enable_sp: bool,
+) -> list[Glm5MTPTransformerBlock.Config]:
+    """Build GLM NextN blocks from the released decoder-block structure."""
+    layers = _build_mtp_layers(
+        inner_cfg, dim=dim, num_mtp_layers=num_mtp_layers, enable_sp=enable_sp
+    )
+    for layer in layers:
+        assert isinstance(layer.attention, Glm5Attention.Config)
+        layer.attention.indexer = copy.deepcopy(indexer)
+        for norm in (layer.enorm, layer.hnorm, layer.mtp_norm):
+            norm.eps = norm_eps
+            norm.param_init = _RMS_NORM_INIT
+        layer.eh_proj.param_init = _LINEAR_INIT
+    return layers
+
+
+_LINEAR_INIT = {
+    "weight": partial(nn.init.trunc_normal_, std=0.02),
+    "bias": nn.init.zeros_,
+}
+_LAYER_NORM_INIT = {"weight": nn.init.ones_, "bias": nn.init.zeros_}
+_RMS_NORM_INIT = {"weight": nn.init.ones_}
+_EMBEDDING_INIT = {"weight": partial(nn.init.normal_, std=1.0)}
+
+
+def _output_linear_init(dim: int) -> dict[str, Callable]:
+    std = dim**-0.5
+    return {
+        "weight": partial(nn.init.trunc_normal_, std=std, a=-3 * std, b=3 * std),
+        "bias": nn.init.zeros_,
+    }
+
+
+def _depth_init(layer_id: int) -> dict[str, Callable]:
+    return {
+        "weight": partial(nn.init.trunc_normal_, std=depth_scaled_std(0.02, layer_id)),
+        "bias": nn.init.zeros_,
+    }
+
+
+def _depth_experts_init(layer_id: int) -> dict[str, Callable]:
+    return {
+        "w1_EFD": partial(nn.init.trunc_normal_, std=0.02),
+        "w2_EDF": partial(nn.init.trunc_normal_, std=depth_scaled_std(0.02, layer_id)),
+        "w3_EFD": partial(nn.init.trunc_normal_, std=depth_scaled_std(0.02, layer_id)),
+    }
+
+
+def make_glm5_attention_config(
+    *,
+    layer_id: int,
+    dim: int,
+    n_heads: int,
+    q_lora_rank: int,
+    kv_lora_rank: int,
+    qk_nope_head_dim: int,
+    qk_rope_head_dim: int,
+    v_head_dim: int,
+    index_n_heads: int,
+    index_head_dim: int,
+    index_topk: int,
+    attention_dropout: float,
+    mla_norm_eps: float,
+    rope: ComplexRoPE.Config,
+    enable_sp: bool,
+    enable_cp: bool,
+) -> Glm5Attention.Config:
+    """Build a fully specified GLM-5 MLA plus DSA attention config.
+
+    Configs are nested instead of constructing modules directly so TorchTitan
+    can validate, shard, pipeline-partition, and initialize the model before
+    materializing parameters on the target device.
+    """
+    base = make_mla_attention_config(
+        layer_id=layer_id,
+        dim=dim,
+        n_heads=n_heads,
+        q_lora_rank=q_lora_rank,
+        kv_lora_rank=kv_lora_rank,
+        qk_nope_head_dim=qk_nope_head_dim,
+        qk_rope_head_dim=qk_rope_head_dim,
+        v_head_dim=v_head_dim,
+        attn_backend="flex",
+        linear_init=_LINEAR_INIT,
+        norm_init=_RMS_NORM_INIT,
+        depth_init=_depth_init,
+        rope=rope,
+        enable_sp=enable_sp,
+        attention_config_factory=lambda _: Glm5FlexAttention.Config(
+            attention_dropout=attention_dropout
+        ),
+    )

+def build_glm5_layers(
+    *,
+    num_layers: int,
+    index_sources: tuple[int, ...],
+    num_dense_layers: int,
+    dim: int,
+    n_heads: int,
+    q_lora_rank: int,
+    kv_lora_rank: int,
+    qk_nope_head_dim: int,
+    qk_rope_head_dim: int,
+    v_head_dim: int,
+    dense_hidden_dim: int,
+    moe_hidden_dim: int,
+    num_experts: int,
+    num_shared_experts: int,
+    router_top_k: int,
+    router_num_expert_groups: int,
+    router_num_limited_groups: int,
+    router_route_scale: float,
+    index_n_heads: int,
+    index_head_dim: int,
+    index_topk: int,
+    attention_dropout: float,
+    mla_norm_eps: float = 1e-6,
+    norm_eps: float = 1e-5,
+    rope: ComplexRoPE.Config,
+    enable_sp: bool = False,
+    enable_cp: bool = False,
+    enable_ep: bool = False,
+) -> list[Glm5TransformerBlock.Config]:
+    """Build GLM-5 dense and MoE block configurations for every layer."""
+    if not 0 <= num_dense_layers <= num_layers:
+        raise ValueError("num_dense_layers must be in [0, num_layers].")
+    if len(index_sources) != num_layers:
+        raise ValueError("index_sources must contain one source per layer")
+    if router_num_expert_groups <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("router_num_expert_groups must be > 0.")
+    if num_experts % router_num_expert_groups != 0:
+        raise ValueError("num_experts must divide evenly into router expert groups.")
+    experts_per_group = num_experts // router_num_expert_groups
+    if experts_per_group < 2:
+        raise ValueError("experts_per_group must be >= 2.")
+    if not 0 < router_num_limited_groups <= router_num_expert_groups:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "router_num_limited_groups must be in [1, router_num_expert_groups]."
+        )
+    if not 0 < router_top_k <= num_experts:
+        raise ValueError("router_top_k must be in [1, num_experts].")
+    if router_top_k > experts_per_group * router_num_limited_groups:
+        raise ValueError("router_top_k exceeds the experts in limited groups.")
+
+    base_layers = build_mla_moe_layers(
+        n_layers=num_layers,
+        n_dense_layers=num_dense_layers,
+        dim=dim,
+        n_heads=n_heads,
+        q_lora_rank=q_lora_rank,
+        kv_lora_rank=kv_lora_rank,
+        qk_nope_head_dim=qk_nope_head_dim,
+        qk_rope_head_dim=qk_rope_head_dim,
+        v_head_dim=v_head_dim,
+        mscale=1.0,
+        dense_hidden_dim=dense_hidden_dim,
+        moe_hidden_dim=moe_hidden_dim,
+        num_experts=num_experts,
+        num_shared_experts=num_shared_experts,
+        router_top_k=router_top_k,
+        router_score_func=Sigmoid.Config(),
+        router_route_scale=router_route_scale,
+        router_route_norm=True,
+        attn_backend="flex",
+        linear_init=_LINEAR_INIT,
+        norm_init=_RMS_NORM_INIT,
+        depth_init=_depth_init,
+        depth_experts_init=_depth_experts_init,
+        rope=rope,
+        router_config_factory=partial(
+            make_deepseek_v3_router_config,
+            num_expert_groups=router_num_expert_groups,
+            num_limited_groups=router_num_limited_groups,
+        ),
+        norm_eps=norm_eps,
+        enable_sp=enable_sp,
+        enable_ep=enable_ep,
+    )
+    layers = []
+    for layer_id, base in enumerate(base_layers):
+        base.attention = make_glm5_attention_config(
+            layer_id=layer_id,
+            dim=dim,
+            n_heads=n_heads,
+            q_lora_rank=q_lora_rank,
+            kv_lora_rank=kv_lora_rank,
+            qk_nope_head_dim=qk_nope_head_dim,
+            qk_rope_head_dim=qk_rope_head_dim,
+            v_head_dim=v_head_dim,
+            index_n_heads=index_n_heads,
+            index_head_dim=index_head_dim,
+            index_topk=index_topk,
+            attention_dropout=attention_dropout,
+            mla_norm_eps=mla_norm_eps,
+            rope=rope,
+            enable_sp=enable_sp,
+            enable_cp=enable_cp,
+        )
+        if index_sources[layer_id] != layer_id:
+            base.attention.indexer = None
+        layers.append(
+            Glm5TransformerBlock.Config(
+                **{
+                    field.name: getattr(base, field.name)
+                    for field in dataclasses.fields(base)
+                }
+            )
+        )
+    return layers
+

+"""Device-neutral GLM-5 model mathematics.
+
+Read this file from the outside in:
+
+1. ``Glm5Model`` supplies token embedding, decoder blocks, final norm, and the
+   language-model head inherited from ``Decoder``.
+2. ``Glm5TransformerBlock`` composes pre-norm DSA attention with either a
+   dense FFN or the common TorchTitan MoE implementation.
+3. ``Glm5Attention`` expands MLA's low-rank Q/KV representations, asks the
+   frozen ``Glm5DsaIndexer`` which keys each query may attend to, and delegates
+   score/value computation to ``Glm5FlexAttention`` in ``dsa.py``.
+4. ``dsa.py`` contains the indexer and token-selected BlockMask construction.
+
+The model uses token-first tensors because TorchTitan packs microbatches into a
+single token dimension before model forward. Distributed placement is declared
+separately in ``sharding.py``; the formulas below describe global logical
+shapes. Distributed adaptation of this sparse path is a separate step.
+"""

+# Tensor dimensions used in this file:
+# T/Q/K: token, query-token, and key-token dimensions.
+# D/N/H/R/P/V: model, head-count, head, RoPE, pass-through, and value dimensions.

+class Glm5Attention(DeepSeekMLAAttention):
+    """Multi-head latent attention (MLA) gated by DSA top-k indices.
+
+    Q follows ``D -> q_lora_rank -> N * (nope + rope)``. KV follows
+    ``D -> (kv_lora_rank + rope)`` and expands only after the low-rank norm.
+    The indexer consumes the same token states and returns ``[T, topk]`` key
+    indices. ``inner_attention`` applies token-selected sparse attention to
+    the expanded Q/K/V tensors.
+    """
+
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class Config(DeepSeekMLAAttention.Config):
+        indexer: Glm5DsaIndexer.Config | None
+
+        @property
+        def qk_head_dim(self) -> int:
+            return self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.qk_rope_head_dim
+
+    def __init__(self, config: Config):
+        super().__init__(config)
+        self.indexer = config.indexer.build() if config.indexer is not None else None
+
+    def forward(  # pyrefly: ignore[bad-param-name-override]
+        self,
+        x_TD: torch.Tensor,
+        attention_masks: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        topk_indices_TS: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        *,
+        return_indices: bool = False,
+        padding_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        aux_loss_denominator: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        x_TD = maybe_gather_tp_input(self, x_TD)
+        T = x_TD.shape[0]
+        if positions is None:
+            positions = torch.arange(T, device=x_TD.device)
+
+        # Query path: compress to LoRA rank R, normalize, then expand to N
+        # heads. Split content (NoPE) from position-sensitive (RoPE) features.
+        q_resid_TR = self.wq_a(x_TD)
+        # RMSNorm reads the saved projection output with bare ops.
+        remat.recompute_needs_tensor(q_resid_TR)
+        q_resid_TR = self.q_norm(q_resid_TR)
+        q_TNH = self.wq_b(q_resid_TR)
+        # The head view/split reads the saved projection output with bare ops.
+        remat.recompute_needs_tensor(q_TNH)
+        with spmd.local():
+            q_TNH = q_TNH.view(T, -1, self.qk_head_dim)
+        # KV path: keep content in a compressed latent representation and keep
+        # one shared rotary key. The expensive per-head expansion happens only
+        # after normalization.
+        compressed_kv_TC = self.wkv_a(x_TD)
+        # The latent split and RMSNorm read this projection with bare ops.
+        remat.recompute_needs_tensor(compressed_kv_TC)
+        kv_TR, k_rope_TR = torch.split(
+            compressed_kv_TC,
+            [self.kv_lora_rank, self.qk_rope_head_dim],
+            dim=-1,
+        )
+        kv_TR = self.kv_norm(kv_TR)
+        q_TNH, k_rope_T1R = self._apply_rope_to_q_and_k_pe(q_TNH, k_rope_TR, positions)
+        with spmd.local():
+            k_shared_TR = k_rope_T1R.squeeze(1)
+        # Selection and value computation are separate on purpose: the indexer
+        # is frozen and discrete, while the attention path remains trainable.
+        if topk_indices_TS is None:
+            if self.indexer is None:
+                raise ValueError("shared-indexer attention requires top-k indices")
+            topk_indices_TS = self.indexer(
+                x_TD, q_resid_TR, positions, attention_masks[0]
+            )
+        output_TNV = self.inner_attention(
+            q_TNH,
+            kv_TR,
+            k_shared_TR,
+            attention_metadata=attention_masks,
+            topk_indices_QS=topk_indices_TS,
+            scale=self.softmax_scale,
+        )
+        # The contiguous view reads the attention output with bare ops.
+        remat.recompute_needs_tensor(output_TNV)
+        output_TD: torch.Tensor = self.wo(output_TNV.contiguous().view(T, -1))
+        assert topk_indices_TS is not None
+        return (output_TD, topk_indices_TS) if return_indices else output_TD
+

+class Glm5TransformerBlock(DeepSeekV3TransformerBlock):
+    """GLM-5 decoder block with either a dense FFN or common MoE."""
+
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class Config(DeepSeekV3TransformerBlock.Config):
+        preserve_output_for_mtp: bool = False
+
+    def __init__(self, config: Config):
+        super().__init__(config)
+        self.preserve_output_for_mtp = config.preserve_output_for_mtp
+
+    def forward(  # pyrefly: ignore[bad-param-name-override]
+        self,
+        x_TD: torch.Tensor,
+        attention_masks: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        topk_indices_TS: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        *,
+        return_indices: bool = False,
+        padding_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        aux_loss_denominator: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if return_indices:
+            attention_TD, topk_indices_TS = self.attention(
+                self.attention_norm(x_TD),
+                attention_masks,
+                positions,
+                topk_indices_TS,
+                return_indices=True,
+            )
+        else:
+            attention_TD = self.attention(
+                self.attention_norm(x_TD),
+                attention_masks,
+                positions,
+                topk_indices_TS,
+            )
+        # The residual add reads the attention output with bare ops.
+        remat.recompute_needs_tensor(attention_TD)
+        x_TD = x_TD + attention_TD
+        normalized_TD = self.ffn_norm(x_TD)
+        if isinstance(self.feed_forward, MoE):
+            ffn_output_TD = self.feed_forward(
+                normalized_TD,
+                padding_mask_T=padding_mask,
+                aux_loss_denominator=aux_loss_denominator,
+            )
+        else:
+            ffn_output_TD = self.feed_forward(normalized_TD)
+        if self.preserve_output_for_mtp:
+            # The saved residual add is a bare consumer of the MoE/FFN result.
+            # MTP's auxiliary backward branch replays this boundary, so declare
+            # the input dependency before entering the non-recomputed region.
+            remat.recompute_needs_tensor(ffn_output_TD)
+        # Trailing add, always saved: it saves nothing for backward, so replay skips
+        # it and its inputs need no persisting, matching checkpoint early stop.
+        output_TD: torch.Tensor = remat.region(
+            torch.add, self.remat_region_name("ffn_residual"), recompute=False
+        )(x_TD, ffn_output_TD)
+        if self.preserve_output_for_mtp:
+            # MTP adds an extra backward branch through the main decoder. Keep
+            # each saved residual boundary materialized for MTP flavors so
+            # selective-AC replay never exposes a metadata placeholder to a
+            # bare consumer. Non-MTP flavors leave this disabled.
+            remat.recompute_needs_tensor(output_TD)
+            output_TD = output_TD.clone()
+        if return_indices:
+            assert topk_indices_TS is not None
+            return output_TD, topk_indices_TS
+        return output_TD
+

+class Glm5Model(DeepSeekV3Model):
+    """GLM-5 decoder with FlexAttention DSA attention.
+
+    The inherited decoder accepts token ids on the first PP stage and hidden
+    states on later stages. A PP stage may own zero decoder layers, which is why
+    mask construction and forward preserve embedding-only/output-only stages.
+    """
+
+    state_dict_adapter_cls = Glm5StateDictAdapter
+
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class Config(DeepSeekV3Model.Config):
+        dim: int = 6144
+        vocab_size: int = 154880
+        index_sources: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+        local_compile_regions: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+        def get_nparams_and_flops(
+            self, model: nn.Module, seq_len: int
+        ) -> tuple[int, int]:
+            attention = self.layers[0].attention
+            assert isinstance(attention, Glm5Attention.Config)
+            nparams, active_nparams = get_nparams_and_active_nparams(model)
+            base_flops = 6 * active_nparams
+            # The common parameter-based estimate charges every parameter for
+            # forward and backward matmuls (6 FLOPs per parameter). GLM-5's
+            # pretrained indexer is frozen and runs under no_grad, so it only
+            # incurs its forward cost (2 FLOPs per parameter). Keep the total
+            # parameter count unchanged while removing the nonexistent
+            # indexer backward work from MFU accounting.
+            nparams_indexer = sum(
+                parameter.numel()
+                for name, parameter in model.named_parameters()
+                if ".attention.indexer." in name
+            )
+            base_flops -= 4 * nparams_indexer
+            # Per token, the indexer computes N dot products of width H against
+            # the full sequence, followed by a weighted reduction over N heads.
+            num_dsa_layers = len(self.layers) + len(self.mtp_layers or ())
+            assert attention.indexer is not None
+            dsa_flops = (
+                2
+                * num_dsa_layers
+                * attention.indexer.n_heads
+                * (attention.indexer.head_dim + 1)
+                * seq_len
+            )
+            return nparams, base_flops + dsa_flops
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _register_optimizer_hooks(
+        cls, optimizers, model_parts, parallelism_context
+    ) -> None:
+        from torchtitan.models.common.moe import register_moe_load_balancing_hook
+
+        register_moe_load_balancing_hook(optimizers, model_parts, parallelism_context)
+
+    def get_attention_masks(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        padding_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        # Pipeline partitioning may create an embedding-only or output-only
+        # stage. Such a stage has no attention operation and needs no mask.
+        if len(self.layers) == 0:
+            return None
+
+        if positions.ndim != 1:
+            raise ValueError("GLM-5 positions must have shape [T].")
+        # Non-first pipeline stages have tok_embeddings pruned away, but each
+        # PP stage containing attention builds its own mask. Every stage
+        # receives the same positions, so any float parameter dtype gives the
+        # same mask dtype; fall back to the first layer's norm weight when
+        # embeddings are absent. layers is a ModuleDict whose keys keep their
+        # original indices after pruning, so iterate values rather than
+        # indexing [0].
+        if self.tok_embeddings is not None:
+            token_dtype = self.tok_embeddings.weight.dtype
+        else:
+            attention_norm = next(iter(self.layers.values())).attention_norm
+            assert isinstance(attention_norm, nn.Module)
+            token_dtype = next(attention_norm.parameters()).dtype
+        return create_dsa_causal_mask(
+            positions,
+            dtype=token_dtype,
+            padding_mask_T=padding_mask,
+        )
+
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__(config)
+        self.index_sources = config.index_sources
+        if self.index_sources:
+            if len(self.index_sources) != len(config.layers):
+                raise ValueError("index_sources must contain one source per layer")
+            for layer, source in enumerate(self.index_sources):
+                if not 0 <= source <= layer or self.index_sources[source] != source:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        "index source must be a current/earlier producer layer"
+                    )
+
+    def preprocess_inputs(
+        self,
+        input_dict: dict[str, Any],
+        *,
+        parallelism_context,
+        parallelism,
+        global_routing_token_counts: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ):
+        """Build the global DSA mask, then CP-shard only its query dimension."""
+        del kwargs
+        loss_kwargs = input_dict.pop("loss_kwargs", {})
+        positions = input_dict.get("positions")
+        if positions is not None:
+            input_dict["attention_masks"] = self.get_attention_masks(
+                positions,
+                input_dict.get("padding_mask"),
+            )
+
+        input_shardings = decoder_input_sharding()
+        input_shardings["attention_masks"] = dsa_mask_placement()
+        depths = (
+            range(1, len(self.mtp_layers) + 1)
+            if self.mtp_layers is not None
+            else range(0)
+        )
+        if self.mtp_layers is not None and positions is None:
+            raise ValueError("GLM-5 MTP input preprocessing requires positions.")
+        for depth in depths:
+            assert positions is not None
+            mtp_tokens, mtp_valid = roll_mtp_sequence(
+                input_dict["input"],
+                shift=depth,
+                positions=positions,
+                padding_mask=input_dict.get("padding_mask"),
+                fill_value=0,
+                return_valid_mask=True,
+            )
+            mtp_labels = roll_mtp_sequence(
+                input_dict["labels"],
+                shift=depth,
+                positions=positions,
+                padding_mask=input_dict.get("padding_mask"),
+                fill_value=IGNORE_INDEX,
+                return_valid_mask=False,
+            )
+            mtp_padding = ~mtp_valid
+            if input_dict.get("padding_mask") is not None:
+                mtp_padding = mtp_padding | input_dict["padding_mask"]
+            input_dict[f"mtp_tokens_{depth}"] = mtp_tokens
+            input_dict[f"mtp_labels_{depth}"] = mtp_labels
+            input_dict[f"mtp_valid_{depth}"] = mtp_valid
+            input_dict[f"mtp_attention_masks_{depth}"] = self.get_attention_masks(
+                positions, mtp_padding
+            )
+            input_shardings[f"mtp_tokens_{depth}"] = input_shardings["input"]
+            input_shardings[f"mtp_labels_{depth}"] = input_shardings["labels"]
+            input_shardings[f"mtp_valid_{depth}"] = input_shardings["input"]
+            input_shardings[f"mtp_attention_masks_{depth}"] = dsa_mask_placement()
+        input_shardings.update(dict.fromkeys(loss_kwargs, input_shardings["labels"]))
+        input_dict.update(loss_kwargs)
+        if parallelism_context.cp_enabled:
+            input_dict = self._cp_shard(
+                input_dict,
+                input_shardings=input_shardings,
+                parallelism_context=parallelism_context,
+                parallelism=parallelism,
+            )
+        input_dict = annotate_input_spmd_types(
+            parallelism_context, input_dict, input_shardings
+        )
+
+        loss_kwargs = {name: input_dict.pop(name) for name in loss_kwargs}
+        inputs = input_dict.pop("input")
+        labels = input_dict.pop("labels")
+        has_aux_loss = next(self.config.traverse(AuxLoss.Config), None) is not None
+        if has_aux_loss or self.mtp_layers:
+            input_dict["aux_loss_denominators"] = global_routing_token_counts
+        if self.mtp_layers is not None:
+            inputs = (inputs, *(input_dict.pop(f"mtp_tokens_{d}") for d in depths))
+            labels = (labels, *(input_dict.pop(f"mtp_labels_{d}") for d in depths))
+            input_dict["mtp_input_valid_masks"] = tuple(
+                input_dict.pop(f"mtp_valid_{d}") for d in depths
+            )
+            input_dict["mtp_attention_masks"] = tuple(
+                input_dict.pop(f"mtp_attention_masks_{d}") for d in depths
+            )
+        return inputs, labels, input_dict, loss_kwargs
+
+    def forward(  # pyrefly: ignore[bad-param-name-override, bad-override]
+        self,
+        tokens: torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, ...],
+        pipeline_indices_TS: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        attention_masks: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        mtp_input_valid_masks: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] | None = None,
+        mtp_attention_masks: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] | None = None,
+        *,
+        padding_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        aux_loss_denominators: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]:
+        # Preserve Decoder's positional ``model(tokens, positions)`` API. PP
+        # metadata is [T, S], while GLM positions are required to be [T].
+        if pipeline_indices_TS is not None and pipeline_indices_TS.ndim == 1:
+            if positions is not None:
+                raise ValueError("positions were provided twice")
+            positions = pipeline_indices_TS
+            pipeline_indices_TS = None
+        main_tokens = tokens[0] if isinstance(tokens, tuple) else tokens
+        if positions is None:
+            positions = torch.arange(main_tokens.shape[0], device=main_tokens.device)
+        if attention_masks is None:
+            attention_masks = self.get_attention_masks(positions, padding_mask)
+        hidden_TD = (
+            self.tok_embeddings(main_tokens)
+            if self.tok_embeddings is not None
+            else main_tokens
+        )
+        index_sources = self.index_sources or tuple(range(len(self.config.layers)))
+        local_layers = {int(name) for name in self.layers}
+        external_sources = {
+            index_sources[layer]
+            for layer in local_layers
+            if index_sources[layer] not in local_layers
+        }
+        indices_by_source: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}
+        aux_loss_denominator = (
+            None if aux_loss_denominators is None else aux_loss_denominators[0]
+        )
+        if external_sources:
+            if pipeline_indices_TS is None:
+                raise ValueError("this GLM-5 PP stage requires DSA indices")
+            source = next(iter(external_sources))
+            indices_by_source[source] = pipeline_indices_TS
+        for name, layer in self.layers.items():
+            layer_id = int(name)
+            source = index_sources[layer_id]
+            hidden_TD, indices_TS = layer(
+                hidden_TD,
+                attention_masks,
+                positions,
+                indices_by_source.get(source),
+                return_indices=True,
+                padding_mask=padding_mask,
+                aux_loss_denominator=aux_loss_denominator,
+            )
+            if source == layer_id:
+                indices_by_source[source] = indices_TS
+        pre_norm_hidden_TD = hidden_TD
+        hidden_TD = self.norm(hidden_TD) if self.norm is not None else hidden_TD
+        if self.mtp_layers is not None:
+            if not isinstance(tokens, tuple) or len(tokens) != len(self.mtp_layers) + 1:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "GLM-5 MTP requires one shifted token tensor per depth."
+                )
+            if mtp_input_valid_masks is None or mtp_attention_masks is None:
+                raise ValueError("GLM-5 MTP requires validity masks and DSA masks.")
+            if self.tok_embeddings is None or self.lm_head is None:
+                raise ValueError("GLM-5 MTP is not supported on a pipeline partition.")
+            mtp_outputs: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+            prev_hidden = pre_norm_hidden_TD
+            depth_inputs = zip(
+                self.mtp_layers,
+                tokens[1:],
+                mtp_input_valid_masks,
+                mtp_attention_masks,
+                strict=True,
+            )
+            for depth, (
+                layer,
+                depth_tokens,
+                valid_mask,
+                depth_attention_mask,
+            ) in enumerate(depth_inputs, 1):
+                aux_denom = (
+                    None
+                    if aux_loss_denominators is None
+                    else aux_loss_denominators[depth]
+                )
+                prev_hidden = layer(
+                    self.tok_embeddings(depth_tokens),
+                    prev_hidden,
+                    valid_mask,
+                    depth_attention_mask,
+                    positions,
+                    padding_mask=padding_mask,
+                    aux_loss_denominator=aux_denom,
+                )
+                mtp_outputs.append(prev_hidden)
+            outputs = (hidden_TD, *mtp_outputs)
+            if self._skip_lm_head:
+                return outputs
+            return tuple(self.lm_head(item) for item in outputs)
+        if self._skip_lm_head or self.lm_head is None:
+            if local_layers:
+                next_layer = max(local_layers) + 1
+                if next_layer < len(index_sources):
+                    source = index_sources[next_layer]
+                    if source != next_layer:
+                        return hidden_TD, indices_by_source[source]
+            return hidden_TD
+        return self.lm_head(hidden_TD)

+"""Declarative SPMD layouts for GLM-5-specific attention components."""
+
+import spmd_types as spmd
+from spmd_types import SpmdType
+
+from torchtitan.distributed.parallelism_context import MeshAxisName
+from torchtitan.models.base.sharding import ShardingConfig
+from torchtitan.models.common.decoder_sharding import (
+    dense_activation_placement,
+    residual_activation_placement,
+    token_id_placement,
+)
+
+DP = MeshAxisName.DP
+CP = MeshAxisName.CP
+TP = MeshAxisName.TP
+
+
+def dsa_mask_placement() -> SpmdType:
+    """Placement for a dense ``(1, query, key)`` legality mask."""
+    return SpmdType(
+        {DP: spmd.V, CP: spmd.V, TP: spmd.R},
+        partition_spec=spmd.PartitionSpec(None, (DP, CP), None),
+    )
+
+
+def glm5_attention_sharding_config(*, enable_sp: bool) -> ShardingConfig:
+    """Keep a GLM attention block on the decoder residual layout."""
+    residual = residual_activation_placement(enable_sp=enable_sp)
+    return ShardingConfig(in_src_shardings={"x_TD": residual})
+
+
+def glm5_inner_attention_sharding_config() -> ShardingConfig:
+    """Extend the common compact MLA boundary with DSA query metadata."""
+    from torchtitan.models.common.decoder_sharding import (
+        mla_attention_local_spmd_sharding_config,
+    )
+
+    config = mla_attention_local_spmd_sharding_config()
+    extra = {
+        "attention_metadata": dsa_mask_placement(),
+        "topk_indices_QS": dense_activation_placement(tp=spmd.R, cp=spmd.S(0)),
+    }
+    assert config.in_src_shardings is not None
+    assert config.in_dst_shardings is not None
+    config.in_src_shardings = {**config.in_src_shardings, **extra}
+    config.in_dst_shardings = {**config.in_dst_shardings, **extra}
+    return config
+
+
+def glm5_indexer_sharding_config() -> ShardingConfig:
+    """Replicate indexer features on TP before the discrete top-k."""
+    activation = dense_activation_placement(tp=spmd.R, cp=spmd.S(0))
+    return ShardingConfig(
+        in_src_shardings={
+            "hidden_states_TD": activation,
+            "q_resid_TR": activation,
+            "positions_T": token_id_placement(),
+            "attention_mask_TK": activation,
+        },

**Must fix: `padding_mask` polarity is inverted.** In torchtitan `padding_mask` is True for padding: see `components/data/collators.py:74,98` (real rows get `zeros`), `packing.py:197` (`constant_values=True`), and the docstring at `common/attention/attention.py:932`. This line keeps `allowed` only where `padding_mask` is True, so every real token's row is fully masked and only padding tokens attend.

`to_input_dict` always passes `padding_mask` (`components/data/types.py:82`), so this hits every training step through the standard data pipeline. Attention output for real tokens becomes empty or uniform, but loss stays finite, which is why the 10-step integration runs didn't catch it. `model.py:409-411` / `mtp.py:61-63` build `mtp_padding = ~valid | padding_mask` with the correct (True = pad) convention and then pass it here, so the code is internally inconsistent.

The tests encode the inverted meaning (`test_glm5_dsa.py:41-45` pass `valid` as `padding_mask_T`, `:71` expects index 1 = `False` to be excluded). The HF parity script uses no padding.

```suggestion
        allowed_TT = allowed_TT & ~padding_mask_T[:, None] & ~padding_mask_T[None, :]
```
Also flip the tests, and add one test that feeds a collator-produced microbatch through `get_attention_masks`.
